bodyStyle.en-US: Inline style of the content area.

bordered.en-US: Whether the card has an outer border.

footerLine.zh-CN: 页脚区与内容区之间是否有边线。
footerLine.en-US: Whether there is a border between the footer and the content area.

footerStyle.en-US: Inline style of the footer area.

headerLine.zh-CN: 标题区与内容区之间是否有边线。
headerLine.en-US: Whether there is a border between the header and the content area.

headerStyle.en-US: Inline style of the header area.

loading.zh-CN: 是否在内容区显示加载占位，开启时根元素的 aria-busy 为 true。
loading.en-US: Whether the content area shows a loading placeholder; the root element's aria-busy is true while on.

shadows.zh-CN: 显示阴影的时机，可选 hover 或 always；不设置则没有阴影。
shadows.en-US: When to show the shadow: hover or always. No shadow when unset.

title.zh-CN: 标题文字，按 6 号标题的样式渲染为 div，超长时省略并显示提示；与 title 插槽等价，两者同时给出时插槽优先。
title.en-US: Title text, rendered as a div styled like a level-6 heading and truncated with a tooltip when too long; equivalent to the title slot, which wins when both are given.

title.zh-CN: 卡片标题；只有一段文字时按 title 属性的样式渲染，其他内容原样渲染。
title.en-US: Card title. A single text renders like the title prop; other content renders as is.

headerExtraContent.en-US: Extra content to the right of the title.

header.zh-CN: 自定义整个标题区，会取代 title 和 headerExtraContent。
header.en-US: Custom header that replaces title and headerExtraContent.

actions.zh-CN: 操作区，每个直接子节点作为一个操作，位于内容区底部，间距 12px。
actions.en-US: Actions at the bottom of the content area, spaced 12px apart; every direct child becomes one action.

title.zh-CN: 标题文字，等价于 title 插槽，两者同时给出时插槽优先。
title.en-US: Title text, equivalent to the title slot, which wins when both are given.

align.zh-CN: 子项的交叉轴对齐方式，传给 Space，可选 start、center、end、baseline。
align.en-US: Cross-axis alignment of the children, passed to Space: start, center, end or baseline.

spacing.zh-CN: 卡片间距，数值或 [水平间距, 垂直间距]；type 为 grid 时不生效。
spacing.en-US: Spacing between cards, a number or [horizontal, vertical]; ignored when type is grid.

type.zh-CN: 设为 grid 时呈现为网格型，覆盖 spacing。
type.en-US: Set to grid for a grid layout, which overrides spacing.

vertical.zh-CN: 是否纵向排列，传给 Space。
vertical.en-US: Whether to lay out vertically, passed to Space.

wrap.zh-CN: 是否换行，传给 Space；纵向排列时不生效。
wrap.en-US: Whether to wrap, passed to Space; ignored when vertical.
